name: jookoi-corporate-env-personal-assistant
description: Corporate second-brain template: plain markdown vault, local WSL/macOS HTTP MCP server, multi-client support.

scripts.// mcp:start: Start the MCP server in foreground (auto-detects macOS, Linux, Git Bash, or WSL).
scripts.// mcp:start:bg: Start the MCP server in background so the current terminal stays free.
scripts.// mcp:start:win: Start the MCP server in foreground using native Windows PowerShell.
scripts.// mcp:start:win:bg: Start the MCP server in background using native Windows PowerShell.
scripts.// mcp:stop: Stop any active jookoi-md-mcp server process (WSL on Windows, native on macOS/Linux).
scripts.// mcp:health: Ping the MCP server health endpoint (http://127.0.0.1:8008/health) to verify index readiness.
scripts.// test: Run the pytest test suite for jookoi-md-mcp (WSL on Windows, native uv on macOS/Linux).
scripts.// mcp:test: Alias for test: runs jookoi-md-mcp pytest suite.
scripts.// paper-trail:list: List active (now) development work items in _architecture/items.yaml.
scripts.// paper-trail:check: Validate the structure and schema conformity of all paper-trail managed files.
scripts.// paper-trail:sweep: Check for unrecorded changes or stale docs across git working tree vs items.yaml.
scripts.// paper-trail:flush: Flush completed and dropped items from items.yaml into _architecture/archive/.
scripts.// skill:link: Links jookoi-brain-mcp and jookoi-brain-api skills to ~/.agents/skills/ for harness discovery.
